goal:
In kestrel-team (Python; gate `uv run --locked python -m pytest tests/ -q`,
fully mocked, no network; base = main after queue/0077 merges), make
`cloud audit`'s `connector_scan` recognise the claude.ai API's condensed
run log. READ CLAUDE.md FIRST. Nothing else changes (0025 decision 2).

Facts (kestrel-helm queue/0077 Record, 2026-10-30). The seat audited cloud
run 0077 with `--run-log` pointing at the API's run log (RemoteTrigger
`get_run_log`), whose tool invocations read
`[2026-10-30T16:17:16.140553Z] tool_use Bash: {"command":"..."}` — 16 such
lines, all Bash. The audit printed `connector_scan PASS only pinned tools
invoked (seen: none)`. `TOOL_CALL_PATTERNS` in `core/cloud_audit.py` (65af10b
lines 87–90) match only the vendor log's `"name": "<Tool>"` and a bare `Tool(`
at line start, so the scan counted nothing; an `mcp__` tool written as
`tool_use mcp__x: {...}` would be caught by `CONNECTOR_TOKEN` alone, and a
pinned-but-not-allowed tool such as `tool_use WebFetch: {...}` would not be
caught at all.

Do this: append to `TOOL_CALL_PATTERNS` exactly this line, as code:
    re.compile(r"\btool_use[ \t]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)[ \t]*(?::|\{)"),
so `tool_use <Tool>:` and `tool_use <Tool>` followed by JSON each count as one
invocation of `<Tool>`; the vendor JSON line (`"tool_use", "name"`) must not be
double-counted (the existing clean-log test asserts `{"Bash": 2, "Read": 1}`).
Extend the comment above the list with the third shape. Tests in
`tests/test_cloud_audit.py`, section 5, one per format, each on a log holding
only that format: `test_connector_scan_vendor_name_format` (`"name":` lines),
`test_connector_scan_bare_call_format` (`⏺ Tool(` lines),
`test_connector_scan_api_tool_use_format` (two `[ts] tool_use Bash: {...}`
lines and one `[ts] tool_use Read {...}` line → PASS, `tools_seen ==
{"Bash": 2, "Read": 1}`); and `test_connector_scan_api_format_mcp_tool_fails`
(`[ts] tool_use mcp__github__create_pull_request: {"title":"x"}` → FAIL,
the name in `check.reason`). `docs/cloud.md` check 5 (65af10b lines 281–286):
the "An invocation is …" sentence names the third shape. Use portable test
fixtures (0076's portability test stays green).
